title: blocksmith.compile-targets.v1 — compile target registry
description: Registry of compilers OUT of Design IR. Every target consumes blocksmith.blocks.v1 and must preserve block id, version, and contentHash traceability. Targets with officialOnly=true (the default and the rule) must never read draft or conflict blocks.

officialOnly.description: Must be true for any target agents or devices consume.

reference.description: Path or URL of the reference implementation.
